svg.title: NeoIPC – Core Module (VLBW/VPT Infants) — Pneumonia
svg.desc: Pneumonia data collection sheet. Sections — Hospital-Acquired Pneumonia, Clinical and Laboratory Criteria, Identified Organisms Recovered from the Respiratory Tract, Secondary Bloodstream Infection (BSI)/Sepsis.
svg.text: These fields serve to unambiguously identify the patient within the hospital. They are not part of the NeoIPC surveillance dataset and must not be transmitted to the data collection
Beginning or increase in respiratory support (required)
Identified Organisms Recovered from the Respiratory Tract
¹ Mark the resistance category appropriate to the isolated organism and answer for that one.
You can select only one option.
For more information, please see the Data Dictionary and Abbreviations sections of the NeoIPC Core Module protocol.
